snippet.title: CultGame Alpha Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST CULTGAME ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2345980/CultGame/

Create your own cult, perform forbidden rituals, and crusade against the filthy non-believers. It's time to play god. CultGame is a cult simulator RPG where you start your own cult in a procedurally generated fantasy world with haunting ASCII art.

After 3 years, CultGame's Alpha is coming to steam, where you can play a demo-sized slice of the game for free and help us shape it into what its final form will be.
